answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Havenbound bridge keeper harbour charter sees to it, since a charter keepers hold after landing inspections. Before the stamp comes a 3-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Every wharf is counted once. One plume, one entry. The haven is on the docket.
